eps.o: A buyer with high expectations keeps his show dog's needs top priority as they search for a home in Kansas City, Missouri. He's on a first-time-buyer's budget, so he'll need to decide whether to compromise on price, location, or his dog's demands.

A married couple is desperate to escape their cramped condo in Fairfax, Virginia. She's their agent with market-driven FOMO and is willing to spend big, but her cautious husband is fighting to protect his snowboarding lifestyle with a lower-priced home.

A young family searches for a historic home in Saint Paul, Minnesota. They're looking for a place that can also accommodate his mom, but his wife and mother are at odds over nearly everything, and he finds himself just trying to keep the peace.

A military couple bought their home sight unseen in Savoy, Illinois, and it's not working for her. She wants design projects and plenty of land for animals, but he's resisting another move since the Air Force could relocate them again in the near future.

After landing a dream job and moving to Chicago, a couple's ready to ditch their high-rise rental and buy a home. It's a highly competitive market, and with two very different backgrounds and opinions on what they want, something will have to give.

A young Gen Z couple's tired of renting and ready to buy their first home in New Jersey. It's a highly competitive real estate market, and with big differences on what kind of house they need, the learning curve might be too steep.

A first-time buyer knows what she wants for her first home in Baltimore. She's looking for a single-family house with a yard in the heart of the city, but her boyfriend's along to help adjust her expectations and rethink what a home can look like.

After the death of his mother, a Maui surfer looks to be closer to family in Florida. He wants everything from fancy toilets to a perfectly square pool, and after seeing 50 homes, his agent and friend is worried he'll never make the move.

After spending his 20-year military career moving all over the country, a former Marine and his wife look to settle down in Texas. She wants a massive house with wow factor in Austin, but he prefers to play it safe and spend less for something in Houston.

A couple's ready to leave their apartment behind and buy their first home in Tampa, Florida. With their debts paid off, he wants to keep costs low and find a fixer-upper, but she's a spender who believes in getting what you want when you want it.
A newlywed couple who are also new parents clash over their first house in Florida. She's paying and wants plenty of renovation projects, but her unemployed husband is desperate to just move in.

An adventurous couple looks to move back to their hometown of Kansas City, Missouri. She's after a major renovation to make their next home unique, but after eight prior project houses, he wants move-in ready.

A pop culture enthusiast couple wants retro style for their first home in Kansas City, Missouri. They're looking for a place that has a '90s vibe, but finding a nostalgic home that isn't too old or isn't in need of a major overhaul may be a challenge.
